clauses.clause: When Omnath enters, it deals damage to any target equal to the number of Elementals you control.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target Elemental you control.
If you control eight or more lands, draw a card.

mapping.notes: Ontology round R12 re-bake (the one quantity comparison, TARGETS, QDistinct, zone counts as QCount): the record's tree translated from its verified 2026-11-05 by claude-verifiers-m20v1 tree, same meaning; it waits for re-verification.

clauses.clause: When Omnath enters, it deals damage to any target equal to the number of Elementals you control.
clauses.evidence: [cast | ask 1 -> X] for X in you_bear, you_giant, opp_flier, opp_tapped, opp_bear, opp_giant, you_elemental, opp_elemental: "card's triggered ability [0] triggers", 'X is targeted', 'X is dealt 2 damage (by card/DEAL_DAMAGE)': 2 is Omnath plus you_elemental; the opponent's opp_elemental and my two non-Elementals are not counted. 'ask target' offers creatures, the player 'you' and 'card' (Omnath itself); no non-creature permanent (you_relic, you_charm). The same 2 damage in [from your hand, the card enters during the opponent's turn]. No variant targets a player: pack G06_1 pins the damage to a player (three Elementals, opponent 20 to 17). G06_7 (an opponent's Elemental under my control is counted). G06_9: the number is counted as the ability resolves (an Elemental leaves in response).

clauses.clause: Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on target Elemental you control.
clauses.evidence: [stimulus: you play a land]: "card's triggered ability [1] triggers", 'ask target: [you_elemental, card]' (my Elementals only, not opp_elemental), 'you_elemental is targeted', 'you_elemental gets 1 PLUS_1_PLUS_1 counter(s)', P/T 2/2 -> 3/3. A land entering under the opponent's control is not in the trace: pack G06_5. G06_6: two lands entering at the same time trigger Landfall twice (two counters). G06_10: the target gone in response, the whole ability does not resolve (no counter, no card).

clauses.clause: If you control eight or more lands, draw a card.
clauses.evidence: [stimulus: you play a land] shows the counter and no draw (fewer than eight lands on my side): the then branch of the Conditional (QTY_GE 8 over lands I control, DRAW 1 me) never runs in the trace. Packs G06_2 (eighth land: counter and a card), G06_3 (seventh: counter, no card), G06_4 (the opponent's lands do not count), G06_5. G06_6 (two lands enter at once: two triggers, two counters, two cards), G06_7/G06_8 (a land that came from the opponent counts toward eight).

survived: each occurrence -> once per event at 1/1
